game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Glowing Heartwood Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about roll_call to power up the forest ranger and open the spirit shrine.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
